name: ArenaKeyValueRow
description: One term and the value against it. Both are strings, because the value of a row in a summary is a formatted answer rather than a component: a price, a method, an address, a count. A slot per row would have made the list a compound family and bought nothing, since every value in every list this replaces is text somebody already formatted.

term.description: What the row is about, rendered as a real dt.

value.description: The answer, rendered as a real dd.

numeric.description: Whether the value is a figure, and takes the mono face and tabular numerals so a column of them aligns by digit. A money column that does not is a column that jitters as it changes.
